title: Blueair 2-in-1 Purifier + Sunrise Alarm Clock — Beige

comparisons.notes: Selected Beige variant, available for shipping at the time checked.

writeup: The beige Blueair combines an air purifier with a sunrise alarm clock, making it a useful option for a small bedside space. Woot’s $51.89 price is 54% below the matching beige model at Target when checked. The savings are on the item price; consider the replacement-filter cost before choosing it.
notes: New; Woot lists a 90-day warranty. Check the manufacturer’s room-size and replacement-filter specifications before buying.
